utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the repair drive. I was meaning to ask if you needed any help carrying stuff over.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’s kind of you, Oren — I could use a hand with the heavier boxes.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I can help with the heavy boxes. Just point me to them, and I’ll carry a few over.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I think I heard something about it, but I might’ve missed the details.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, it’s the repair drive this weekend — people are dropping off broken small appliances and bikes, and we’ll sort out what can be fixed. I’ll send you the exact time and place once I confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, great — send me the time and place when you have it, and I’ll try to swing by.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did we get the repair drive schedule तय yet, or do I need to bring my tools tomorrow?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Not yet — I’m still waiting on the final schedule. If you bring your tools tomorrow, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’ll bring them tomorrow, then. Just let me know if the time changes.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Opal, the repair drive's coming up soon — want me to pass along the invite?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, please pass it along — I’d like the location details too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the invite and send over the location details too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — what do you need help with for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you double-check the date and the drop-off location for the repair drive? I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I share anything.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can double-check those details for you. Let me verify the date and drop-off location, and I’ll get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Leo — could you bring your tool kit and a few boxes of screws and nails? That would really help us get started.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll bring my tool kit and a few boxes of screws and nails.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll keep the repair drive organized and make sure everyone knows what to bring. Let’s start by listing the biggest fixes we need first.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — just keep it simple and I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great — let’s start with the most urgent fixes and keep a simple list everyone can follow. I’ll jot them down and we can assign a few easy tasks to get rolling.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d want to know the pickup time and where we’re meeting so I can plan ahead.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Of course — let’s meet at 9 a.m. by the community center, and I’ll have the pickup details ready.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that works for me — I’ll plan on 9 a.m. by the community center and wait for the pickup details.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good—I’ll keep an ear out for any repair drive updates while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Ira — I’d really appreciate that. I seem to hear about these things second-hand, so any updates help.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course — if I hear anything, I’ll pass it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what supplies we still need for the repair drive and make a quick list.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm the list is just the basics, or are we still missing anything major?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It should be just the basics for now, but I’ll double-check if we’re missing anything major and let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Jules — I can lend a hand if you need a tool or two for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Gus — that’d be a huge help. I’ll let you know what tools we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — just send me the list when you have it, and I’ll see what I can lend.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time does the repair drive need to happen?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be wonderful, Faye — I was thinking Saturday morning, maybe around 9, so folks can come by after breakfast.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday morning at 9 works for me—I can help spread the word and plan around school stuff.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule for the repair drive. What do you need me to line up?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d be huge, Faye — if you can line up the school schedule, I’ll handle the volunteer list and tool drop-off times.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, I’ll check the school calendar and see what windows work best. Send me the volunteer list once you have it, and I’ll match the schedule around it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Have we set the repair drive date yet, Hana?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Not yet — let me double-check the details before I confirm anything.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay, what details are you still checking?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, is the repair drive still happening today?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s still on for today — people are bringing things by all afternoon. I’ll let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks for confirming. I’ll probably stop by later this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll get the repair drive organized and keep everyone in the loop. Let me know what you need from me first.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep an eye on the supply list and check what’s still missing. Just tell me what to gather first.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great — please start with tape, zip ties, and a few spare batteries if you can. I’ll message the block and keep the list updated as we go.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help a little, but I need to keep things low-key today.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: No worries — low-key is fine. Just let me know what you can take on.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can handle sorting and labeling a few boxes, but I’d rather stay out of the spotlight today.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I only heard about the repair drive second-hand—what do you need me to know?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—sorry, I’m still getting my notes straight. We’re just trying to round up tools, supplies, and a few extra hands, and I can fill you in on the details if you want.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be great—what tools or supplies are you short on? I can help if I can.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure thing — what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I think it’s still moving along, but I might’ve missed the newest update. What changed?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll just check the latest update and keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what would be most useful to take on first?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Mara — could you start by organizing the donated tools and checking what still needs to be gathered?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely—I’ll sort the donated tools and make a list of anything still missing.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m putting together the repair drive invites now—want me to add you to the list?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, please do — I can bring my tool kit and help out.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll put you on the list right now. Your tool kit will be a huge help!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m late again, but I can still help with the repair drive—what do you need me to take care of?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Could you head to the community center first and check the donation table? Then bring any extra tools back to the church hall.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: On it—I’ll check the donation table at the community center and bring any extra tools back to the church hall.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I just heard the repair drive is picking up donations fast. I’ll swing by after my errands and see what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’s really helpful, Ira. I’ll keep an eye on what’s still needed until you get back.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll check in when I’m back and see where I can help most.
